implementation: Gemini vision-language model (gemini-2.5-flash) observes an open box photo and reports item presence, quantity and unlisted items as structured JSON. A deterministic rules engine converts the observation into PASS/FAIL/UNCERTAIN per check_key. Falls back to CSV replay when no images are supplied (test/stub mode). Ported from Round 2 repo: https://github.com/Shyamyemuka/cube26-pck-0105-shyamyemuka
notes: Requires GEMINI_API_KEY env var for the real (vision) path. Without it, the agent replays Round 2 sample CSV data and tests pass.
